_note: One-minute Pip & Willow relationship episodes, in order: each 14 shots of ~4.5s. Koalas stand in for a couple; every episode is a relatable relationship moment with a POV hook in the first second. 'say' lines are voiced (cute pitched voices) and subtitled; 'sfx' steers the automatic sound design. Setting: the hot Australian bush. Pip = male, taller, mustard scarf. Willow = female, petite, pink blossoms and pink heart patch. The picture in koala/refs/ is the final word on how they look.
